11.note: ‘accessible’通常与 by/to 连用，意思是易于到达的、可进入的，常用于形容交通的便利性。

choices.eg: Free Wi-Fi is available in all public areas of the hotel.

12.note: ‘resourceful’意思是足智多谋的、机智的，形容在缺乏资源时善于寻找解决方法的能力。

choices.zh: 足智多谋的，善于解决问题的

The industrious workers completed the house building before the winter.

13.zh: “虽然我们不能完全确定，但严重食物中毒后的恢复时间通常为一周，”医生补充道。
13.note: ‘generally’意思是通常、普遍地，符合医生针对无法确定的病情做出一般性推断的语境。

choices.eg: The train arrived at exactly noon, just as the schedule stated.
The weather in this coastal city is generally warm and sunny.
He is constantly checking his phone for new work updates.
This product was specifically designed for people with sensitive skin.

14.note: ‘wore off’是短语动词，意思是（药效、感觉或疼痛）逐渐消退、消失。

choices.eg: As the boring presentation wore on, some people fell asleep.
The effects of the anesthesia began to wear off after the surgery.
The long, steep mountain hike completely wore out the young tourists.

26.note: “underwent an extensive revamp” 意为“经历了全面的翻新”，修饰单数可数名词revamp，且形容词extensive以元音音素开头，故用an。

27.note: 先行词是“prisoners of war (POWs) and civilians”（战俘与平民，指人），在定语从句中作主语，故用关系代词who引导。

28.note: “built by POWs” 意为“由战俘们所建造”，此处为被动语态的省略形式，用介词by引出动作的执行者。

29.note: “where prisoners could find comfort...” 意为“战俘们可以在那里寻得一丝慰藉”，表示在过去艰苦环境下的可能性与能力，故用could。

30.note: “a quiet space for reflection” 意为“一个供人沉思的宁静空间”，用介词for引出空间的特定用途或目的。

31.note: “is home to...” 为固定搭配，意为“是……的所在地/家园”。

32.note: “its own story of resilience” 意为“它自己的关于坚韧的故事”，用its指代前面提到的单数名词“Every artefact”（每件文物）。

33.note: 先行词是单数名词短语“its own story of resilience”，指物，在非限制性定语从句中作主语，故用which引导。

34.note: “should make a visit to this site” 意为“应当去参观这个遗址”，此处作情态动词表示对历史感兴趣的人的推荐或建议。

35.note: “bridges the gap between A and B” 为固定搭配，意为“消除/弥合A与B之间的差距（连接过去与现在）”，置于句首需大写。

cloze: The Changi Chapel and Museum stands as a reminder of Singapore's wartime history.

Originally opened in 2001, the museum underwent [Q26] extensive revamp to modernise itself. It serves to honour the prisoners of war (POWs) and civilians [Q27] were held in the Changi area during the Japanese Occupation.

The original chapel was built [Q28] POWs during their imprisonment. These brave individuals used whatever materials they could find, such as attap leaves and scrap metal, to construct a place of worship. The chapel provided a crucial sanctuary where prisoners [Q29] find comfort amidst harsh conditions. Today, a faithful replica of the chapel sits in the open-air area of the museum, allowing visitors a quiet space [Q30] reflection.

The main exhibition area is home [Q31] a massive collection of personal items, photographs, and letters donated by the survivors and their families. Every artefact has [Q32] own story of resilience [Q33] has been preserved for future generations. For example, visitors can view secret messages hidden within everyday objects, demonstrating the creativity of the prisoners.

Anyone who is interested in history [Q34] make a visit to this site. It bridges the gap [Q35] the painful past and the peaceful present, teaching the younger generation the true value of psychological defence and strength.
zh: 樟宜礼拜堂与博物馆是新加坡战时历史的见证与提醒。
该博物馆最初于2001年开放，随后经历了一次全面的翻新以实现现代化。它的设立是为了向在日本占领期间被关押在樟宜地区的战俘（POW）和平民表达敬意。
最初的礼拜堂是由战俘在被监禁期间建造的。这些勇敢的人利用了他们能找到的任何材料（例如亚答叶和废金属）来建造一个朝拜场所。礼拜堂提供了一个关键的庇护所，战俘们可以在艰苦的环境中寻得一丝慰藉。如今，一座忠实还原该礼拜堂的复制品坐落在博物馆的露天区域，为游客提供了一个沉思的宁静空间。
主展览区馆藏着由幸存者及其家属捐赠的大量个人物品、照片和书信。每件文物都有它自己关于坚韧的故事，并且这些故事已被保存下来供后代铭记。例如，游客可以一睹隐藏在日常用品中的秘密信息，这展现了战俘们的创造力。
任何对历史感兴趣的人都应当去参观这个遗址。它弥合了痛苦的过去与和平的现在之间的鸿沟，教导年轻一代心理防线与力量的真正价值。

61.stem_plain: Jade admired her grandfather as he was wise.

62.stem_plain: Both the bicycle shops in the park are closed today.

63.stem_plain: The electrician fixed the lights. They now work perfectly.

64.stem_plain: "Did you remember to return the library book?" Jill asked Jack.

65.stem_plain: My aunt was upset about the rude staff. She complained to the manager.

61.concept: 词性转换 — 形容词变名词 (wise -> wisdom)
61.zh: 翡翠因为她祖父的聪明才智而钦佩他。
61.note: 改写要点：because of 是复合介词，后面应接名词或名词短语。需要将形容词 wise 转换为对应的名词形式 wisdom，并结合物主代词组成 his wisdom 放在 because of 后面。
61.answer: Jade admired her grandfather because of his wisdom.

62.concept: 代词转换与主谓一致 — Neither of 结构的肯定转换
62.zh: 公园里的两家自行车店今天都没有开门。
62.note: 改写要点：Neither of 后面接复数名词短语 the bicycle shops in the park。依据语法规则，Neither of + 复数名词作主语时，谓语动词在正式语体中通常用单数，但原句 are closed 表状态，也可以用 is closed 表示“两个中没有一个是……”。在新加坡PSLE的标准答案中，Neither of the bicycle shops in the park is open today / is closed today，需要特别注意原句 closed 与 open 的表述转换以保持句意完全一致，即原句“都关了”等于“没有一个是开着的”或者使用肯定形式配合 neither 的否定语义：Neither of the bicycle shops in the park is open today。
62.answer: Neither of the bicycle shops in the park is open today.

63.concept: 词性转换与介词短语修饰 — 动词变名词 (fixed -> fix / fixing)
63.zh: 由于电工的修理，灯现在运行得很完美。
63.note: 改写要点：as a result of 后面必须跟名词短语。将第一个句子的主谓结构转换为 the electrician's fix 或 the electrician fixing the lights 这一所有格/动名词短语形式，前半句作为结果顺接：The lights now work perfectly as a result of the electrician's fix。
63.answer: The lights now work perfectly as a result of the electrician's fix.

64.concept: 间接引语 — 一般疑问句的转述与时态/人称代词转换
64.zh: 吉尔问杰克他是否记得还图书馆的书。
64.note: 改写要点：1. 一般疑问句用 if 引导，后接陈述句语序；2. 一般过去时（did remember）向后推一个时态变为过去完成时（had remembered）；3. 人称代词转换：you -> he。
64.answer: Jill asked Jack if he had remembered to return the library book.

65.concept: 句式合并与词性转换 — 动词变名词 (complained -> complaint)
65.zh: 我阿姨对粗鲁的员工感到很不高兴，并向经理提出了投诉。
65.note: 改写要点：根据提示词 and made，需要将动词 complained 转换为名词短语 made a complaint。前半句保留完整的主谓结构，连接词 and 后省略重复的主语 she：My aunt was upset about the rude staff and made a complaint to the manager。
65.answer: My aunt was upset about the rude staff and made a complaint to the manager.
